messages.subject: A Return Label?
messages.text:
Hi there. Thanks so much for refunding my money for order L-41879. Unfortunately, I never received a return label from you so that I may return the items you refunded for me. Can you please email one to me and I will gladly return the scarves.
 

 Sincerely,
 

 Amy Chamberlin

messages.subject: Re: A Return Label?
messages.text:
Hi Amy,

You've been waiting on this return label for far too long, and we never followed through on what we told you. That's on us, and I'm sorry for the runaround.

I'll get a prepaid return label sent to you directly at this email address. Once you have it, just pack the scarves and drop the package off at the location indicated on the label.

Thanks for your patience through all of this, we'll get it wrapped up.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
